QUOTE: `server_data_operator/index.ts` does `mix(ServerDataOperatorBase).with(...13 mixins...)`. Each mixin is a factory `(superclass) => class extends superclass`, and `mix` applies them left to right (`app/utils/mix.ts`).
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer states that ServerDataOperator is built via `mix(ServerDataOperatorBase).with(...)` with handler mixins rather than declaring handlers itself.
